# EWS mark-all success can request a per-message fallback instead of marking a folder

The bridge starts a detached operation. Before Exchange2013, the Rust operation returns UseLegacyFallback::Yes without a mark-all request. The native callback then enumerates locally known unread messages and starts the per-message operation, whose later callback updates successful headers. For a supported server, the response precedes local mark-all, commit and optional window undo. The fallback branch does not add that mark-all undo action. A successful initial callback therefore does not establish completion of the fallback or of every message on the server.

Scope: Exchange folder read-state completion.
